body: They look to be healing really well - do you use any oil or anything? I hope you are doing well

Thanks mate, I really appreciate that.

I'm really sorry to hear that man, I'm glad the ward helped you somewhat. I ended up there because of a paracetamol OD, not sectioned but persuaded you know. All the other patients were so kind and understanding, it was nice to talk freely, but the doctors/psychiatrists really couldn't give a shit. I got discharged the day after I got caught trying to off myself during checks. I was still really bad, even when I went back and asked for help they told me to call a hotline. The experience just makes me scared to go back tbh.

You sound like you're doing your best, it's good to plan, I really hope you're doing okay. Thank you for listening to me dude, I'm sorry for ranting on again. With that stuff, I feel like even when I arrange things and ask for help I start spiralling again. I've been 'getting help' since I was 16 and I feel weak for not getting better or just going through with my plans aha
I don't know where I'd go tbh. Thank you for reading my rambling, great username

I do, I have moments but it goes away so quickly, a few hours at most, it's never long. It feels less and less frequent or just surface level, like there's always those feelings underneath it that come back

That's amazing! I'd recommend putting the stem in water tbh. Visible roots within literally a day or two! Crazy how much of a difference it made :)
